# voipms_dids (Data Source)

Lists all DIDs on the account (`getDIDsInfo`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_dids" "all" {}

output "did_routing" {
  value = { for d in data.voipms_dids.all.dids : d.did => d.routing }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `dids` (Attributes List) DIDs on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dids))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`dids`).
